findings.claim: Shared scalar table proves conditional fallback and constant cases, but not the sentinel runtime selector.
evidence: 0x14215cc10 entries 0/1/2 are 0x140396bd0/0x140396be0/0x140396bf0. Entry 0 MOVAPS XMM0,XMM3; RET. Sampler zeros XMM3 before each call, including 0x1403c9cf1 for IRad.
Entry 1 loads curve=*RCX then MOVSS XMM0,[curve+4]; no time arithmetic. Entry 2 uses scalar SSE single-precision operations and dword/word header reads.

0x140396c21..0x140396c43 selects XMM1 when header bits2..3<2, otherwise XMM2, via integer bit selection. First/last key times are u16 &0x3fff converted to float; COMISS/JBE gates pre/post/in-range paths.
Entry 2 tail-dispatches through 0x14215cc40, 0x14215cc58, or interpolation table 0x14215cbf8 after call 0x1403969e0; these downstream routines were not followed.
limitations: Implementable conditional contract only: selector 0 returns exact caller +0.0f; selector 1 returns stored float bits at curve+4. Sentinel header/initialization not proven, so absent IRad cannot yet be assigned numeric zero.
Selector 3 is not a validated branch: the fourth qword is ASCII/string bytes, not a code pointer. No generic malformed-header safety fallback is proved.
Full interpolation, extrapolation, precision/order beyond this wrapper, NaN behavior and any process FP mode are unresolved.

findings.claim: A type-7 virtual callback resamples and hands IRad to a concrete host-call argument behind an enable gate.
evidence: Vtable 0x142161700+0xf8 -> 0x1403c9d80. It calls sampler at 0x1403c9d9c. CHAININFO proves 0x1403c9dbc..0x1403c9f7f and epilogue 0x1403c9f7f..0x1403c9f88 belong to this callback.
0x1403c9da1..0x1403c9db6 tests bit13 of word [[runtime+0x1f8]+0x4a8]; clear skips host handoff, although sampling already occurred.
0x1403c9f00 loads runtime +0x23c, 0x1403c9f4c stores it at caller RSP+0x20 (argument 5; callee entry RSP+0x28), then 0x1403c9f5a calls 0x1403b64a0.

Host call arguments: RCX=return of 0x1403b4f80; XMM1=Len, XMM2=Str, XMM3=Gra; stack args5/6=IRad/ORad, arg7=return of runtime+0x200 vcall +0x28 plus 0x24, arg8=base-position pointer, args9/10=FSDc/FEDc, arg11=dword [[runtime+0x1f8]+0x438].
FaBP at radial+0x30 selects base-position path: 0 uses TLS +0x3c/+0x40/+0x44; 1 tries a virtual position call and falls back to TLS on false; other values retain initial zero vector.
limitations: This proves caller-side numeric parameter handoff, not the callee write, named render parameter, shader/normalization/fade formula, or actual active callback scheduling. No meaning assigned to gate bit13 or arg11 without further source.
